neighbours.label: A digit that repeats the digit right before it, inside a phone number, code or similar digit string ('66', '44', '99'); the same strings with no adjacent repeat stay quiet.
fire: The fax is (212) 644-3310 in the city.
The color is #226611 on the page.
The office line is 253-0177 all day.
quiet: The fax is (212) 647-3510 in the city.
The color is #216513 on the page.
The office line is 253-0172 all day.

notes: Probes: 0.56-0.83 on repeats in number strings, under 0.13 without. 'Room 55' read only 0.21, so short standalone numbers are weaker. Every near miss was checked to have no adjacent repeat.
